title: 敞厅 Chang Ting
subtitle: Qichun Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.7 m, eave 4.4 m, ridge 7.32 m above the ground
hip-and-gable 歇山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

searched: No text or drawing names it in 養吉齋叢錄 j18, modern studies of 绮春园, what search indexes show of the Yangshi Lei drawings; 日下旧闻考 does not cover this garden, and Jiaqing's 三十景 poems could not be reached (wishlist).
